description: View DSL with HTML helpers, Builder, auto-escaping, layouts, and partials. Implements the internal Builder type and HTML helper functions that write to it, plus a render system.
steps: Create src/stdlib_view.c implementing the view/html package. Implement a Builder struct (growable byte buffer, 4KB initial, doubling growth). Builder functions: builder_init, builder_write, builder_write_str, builder_write_escaped (escapes & < > " '), builder_finish (returns ObjString), builder_free.

Implement HTML helper native functions that write to a thread-local or global Builder: html, head, body, div, span, p, h1-h6, a, ul, ol, li, form, input, button, label, textarea, select, option, table, tr, td, th, header, footer, main, nav, section, article, img, br, hr, meta, link, title, script, style, small, strong, em, pre, code. Each takes attributes as a map and content as a string or closure.

The helpers follow this pattern: tag(attrs_map_or_string, content_closure_or_string). If first arg is a string, it's treated as text content. If first arg is a map, it's attributes. If second arg is a closure, call it (nested helpers). Generate proper opening/closing tags. Void elements (br, hr, img, input, meta, link) are self-closing.
Implement auto-escaping: all string content passed to helpers is HTML-escaped via builder_write_escaped. Implement raw(string) helper that writes unescaped content.
Implement render_inline(closure) - creates a new Builder, calls the closure, finishes the Builder to produce the final HTML string, returns it as an ObjString Value.
Implement doctype(type) helper - writes '<!DOCTYPE html>' for :html5.

Register the view package in vek_stdlib.c/vek_stdlib.h. The helpers (h1, div, a, form, etc.) should be registered as top-level globals (not under a package prefix) since the design shows them called directly like h1(...), div(...) etc. Alternatively register them under a 'html' package so they can be called as html.h1(...), html.div(...). Given the design shows them called bare, register them as globals.
Create tests/test_view.c unit tests: test Builder grow, test HTML escaping, test tag generation with attributes, test nested tags, test void elements, test raw() bypasses escaping.
Create tests/programs/stdlib_view.ve + tests/programs/stdlib_view.expected integration test exercising the view DSL from vek code.
acceptance_criteria: Nested helpers produce properly nested HTML
render_inline returns the complete HTML string
